_comment: Bettor profile for the NFL picks agent. No phone numbers or secrets belong in this file; those live in the cloud environment settings.

prizepicks.notes: DFS pick'em. Power (all must hit) and Flex (can miss 1, sometimes 2). Goblin lines = lower line, lower payout, higher hit rate. Demon lines = higher line, higher payout.

underdog.notes: DFS pick'em. Standard (all must hit) and Flex/Insurance entries. Shows discounted/alt lines with different multipliers.

betr.notes: Betr Picks. Verify Georgia availability in-app before each season; not confirmed by public sources.

kalshi.notes: CFTC prediction market; sports contracts available in GA. Price = implied probability. Has player-prop ladders (10+, 20+ ...).

polymarket.notes: Prediction market; game moneylines and spreads. Watch volume for where the big money is.

rules: Default stake is $10 for conservative 2-3 pick entries.
Thursday Night Football entries: cut stake by half and prefer unders / lower-variance props.

strategy.conservative_core: 2-3 pick Power/Standard entries built from legs with an estimated hit rate of 62% or higher (goblin/discounted lines, low thresholds, strong usage).
strategy.sprinkle: 4-6 pick Flex entries mixing the safest legs with 1-2 favorable-matchup legs that carry a big multiplier.
strategy.game_bets: Skip straight game bets. Consider a game parlay only if it pays 3x or more.
strategy.promos: Use ongoing (non-introductory) promos and discounted lines; ignore new-user-only offers.
strategy.tnf_caution: Thursday Night Football produces outlier results (short rest, sloppy play). Lower confidence one tier, favor unders and floor props, and avoid stacking more than one TNF leg in a Power entry.
strategy.correlation: Avoid two legs that need opposite game scripts. Positive correlations (QB pass yds + his WR1 rec yds) are fine on Flex entries.

alerts.fantasy_side_notes: Not a fantasy agent. Only mention: a player in the user's Yahoo lineups who is ruled out, or a standout waiver pickup noticed while researching.
